# Load dataset

```{r}
pop=read_xlsx("C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\Data\\population_hui_like_dur.xlsx") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(date,dateonset,starttrial,lastvisit,trialdate),as.Date)) %>%
```

# Sample trial data

## Point estimate

```{r}
set.seed(03111963)
trialdf=trial_sampler(pop,id,trt_overall,20,50) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(id=cur_group_id())
```

## Boostrapping

```{r}
boot_sample=bootstrap_sampler(trialdf,id,trt_overall,20,50) %>% 
  arrange(id,timen)
```

# Matching

Define methods

```{r}
grid=c("duration_matching","exact_greedy","exact_optimal",
                   "psm_p_greedy_noc","psm_p_greedy_caliper_01","psm_p_greedy_caliper_005",
                   "psm_m_greedy_noc","psm_m_greedy_caliper_01","psm_m_greedy_caliper_005",
                   "psm_p_optimal","psm_m_optimal")
```

## Point estimate

Run matching procedure

```{r,eval=FALSE}
matched=matching_call(data=trialdf,id,ratio=1,methods=grid[1])
```

Run model

```{r}
point=run_all_matching(data=trialdf,ratio=2,methods=grid)
```

## Bootstrapping

Loop

```{r}
B=3;points=data.frame()
for (b in 1:B){
  # bootstrap from dataset
  boot_sample=bootstrap_sampler(trialdf,id,trt_overall,20,50)
  # run procedures
  point=run_all_matching(data=boot_sample,id=id,ratio=2,methods=grid)
  # attach number of iteration
  point$b=b
  # bind
  points=bind_rows(points,point)
}
```
